explanation: U -> C U is a K-linear map L. Full row rank makes C.mulVecLin surjective (Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq), hence L surjective (solve column by column with choose). By rank-nullity (LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker, finrank_matrix) dim ker L = (k - |iota|) n, using |iota| <= k from rank_le_card_width. Every fiber of L has the size of the kernel fiber (AddMonoidHom.card_fiber_eq_of_mem_range), which is |K|^dim ker (Module.card_eq_pow_finrank). The sum identity follows by Fintype.sum_fiberwise and the translation R -> R + W (Fintype.sum_equiv with Equiv.addRight).
